content.value: A PLC manufacturing company has three production units namely X, Y, and Z which produces 40%, 35%, and 25% of the entire production, respectively. Unit X is known to produce 15% defectives, Unit Y produces 8% defective and Unit Z produces 0% defectives. If total 5500 PLCs were manufactured in December 2021, how many products were defectives? If an item is found to be defective, what is the probability that is was produced in Unit Y?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
